diagnosis: MRT Pharma page-refresh authentication failure (DIAGNOSIS ONLY)

manual_evidence.error_string: Could not load oidc settings from local storage. Ensure the client is configured properly

source_investigation.SIGNIN_CALLBACK_AUTH_CLIENT_SOURCE: throwaway new BrowserAuthorizationClient({}) inside the static method
source_investigation.AUTH_CLIENT_REHYDRATION_ON_HARD_REFRESH: viewer route recreates the client; callback route does NOT create the app client
source_investigation.signin_redirect_initiator: only /viewer route (LiveItwinViewer.signInRedirect); /signin-callback never writes oidc settings

root_cause.PAGE_REFRESH_AUTH_ROOT_CAUSE: Hard refresh of /signin-callback re-invokes static handleSignInCallback(), which requires localStorage['oidc.<state>'] — a one-time entry written by signinRedirect and consumed/removed by the first successful callback. On refresh it is absent, so the library throws. The callback route treats a re-loaded consumed callback as a live one and surfaces the raw error instead of routing onward.
root_cause.not_the_cause: PKCE config correct; redirect URI matches; app viewer client configured properly

recommended_narrow_correction_not_applie.approach: detect absent localStorage['oidc.<state>'] (or catch this specific settings error) and navigate('/viewer', replace) instead of showing an error; optionally strip consumed code/state query params
